name: Fujian Wanchen Food Group
what: Operator of snack and grocery discount-store chains in China (Hao Xiang Lai and Lao Jin Tang style value snack stores), renamed from Wanchen Biotechnology Group in January 2026. Trailing revenue about CNY 57bn, 2025 revenue CNY 51.5bn; filed for a Hong Kong H-share listing in March 2026.
source_note: Market cap about CNY 41.09 billion (close 205.22 on 2026-07-28); CNY 39.58bn on 2026-04-28

name: Fresh Life Style (Xianshenghuo)
what: Cold-chain logistics and farm-to-factory fresh produce supply chain platform backed by New Hope Group; began overseas expansion in 2022. Raised Series A and B totalling roughly USD 220M.
last_round: Series B, about CNY 900M (USD 126M total B), 2022-03
investors: Longfor Capital, CICC Capital, Far East Horizon, New Hope Group
source_note: Series A CNY 600M (USD 93M) Jan 2021; unicorn at CNY 10bn (USD 1.4bn) valuation on Series B Mar 2022; Series B total near CNY 900M (USD 125.8M) per DealStreetAsia

name: Tengdun Technology (Sichuan Tengden Sci-Tech Innovation)
what: Maker of medium-to-large unmanned aerial systems (Twin-Tail Scorpion fixed-wing, Hunjianglong amphibious drone, helicopter drones); IPO on Shenzhen ChiNext accepted June 2026 seeking about CNY 3.0bn. Mainly military and government customers.
last_round: Series C+, over CNY 1bn, 2023-07; further round 2025-06 undisclosed
investors: Sichuan Industrial Fund, Sichuan Development, Huakong Fund, SDIC Chuangyi, Boyuan Capital, CICC Capital
source_note: Valuation over 12.2 billion yuan based on July 2023 Series C+ round

name: CoreUnite Power (Xinlian Power)
what: Compound-semiconductor / power-chip company for data-center markets founded in 2023 with SAIC, XPeng, Bosch, CATL and Sungrow as founding shareholders. Closed a Series C of nearly CNY 2bn in November 2026.
investors: Industrial capital from communications, computing, power grid, new energy and automotive sectors
source_note: Series C financing of nearly 2 billion RMB, valuation of 2 billion US dollars (2026-11-02)

name: Jiangsu Hengshun Vinegar-Industry
what: Maker of Zhenjiang Hengshun aromatic vinegar and condiments, a long-established Chinese food brand sold nationwide and exported.
source_note: Market cap 8.28B CNY at share price 7.48 CNY (2026-05-08)

name: Jiugui Liquor
what: Baijiu producer (Jiugui brand, Jiugui Jiu) listed in Shenzhen, selling premium liquor and health liquor across China.
source_note: Jiugui Liquor at 18.3 billion (CNY) on January 6, 2026

name: Sinomine Resource Group
what: Mining and specialty metals group (lithium, cesium, tantalum, tin) with mines in Zimbabwe, Namibia and Canada; supplies battery and electronics industries.
source_note: Investing.com: market cap 38.02B CNY at 52.50 CNY on 2026-08-06 (stockanalysis 61.19B CNY on 2026-04-28)

name: Ningbo Ronbay New Energy Technology
what: Producer of lithium-ion battery cathode materials (high-nickel ternary precursors and cathodes) for EV and energy storage battery makers; about 704M shares outstanding.
source_note: Market cap 26.90B CNY on 2026-05-07; PitchBook USD 3.42B on 2026-06-04

name: Hunan Changyuan Lico
what: Maker of lithium battery cathode materials (ternary and lithium iron phosphate) supplying EV battery makers; trailing revenue about USD 1.5bn.
source_note: PitchBook: market cap about USD 2.23B as of 4 Aug 2026, share price USD 1.16, 1.93B shares
